historic_nodes_read.name: engine.go
historic_nodes_read.summary: Core StrategyEngine and shared kernel types: builds candidate coin lists from configurable sources (static, AI500, OI rankings, Hyperliquid), fetches market/quant/external data, and gates futures decision cycles on CME session and contract expiry.
historic_nodes_read.languageNotes: Defines the high-cascade Context/Decision types consumed by the engine, store, and web UI — do not change their shape casually.

historic_nodes_read.name: PositionInfo
historic_nodes_read.summary: Snapshot of an open position (entry/mark price, quantity, leverage, PnL, liquidation) fed into the AI context.

historic_nodes_read.name: AccountInfo
historic_nodes_read.summary: Account equity, balance, and margin snapshot included in every decision context.

historic_nodes_read.name: Context
historic_nodes_read.summary: The full AI decision context: time, account, positions, candidate coins, prompt variant, trading stats, and multi-timeframe market data — the input to prompt building.

historic_nodes_read.name: Decision
historic_nodes_read.summary: A single AI trading decision (action, symbol, stops, leverage, confidence, risk) — the high-cascade JSON shape read by engine, DB, and web UI.

historic_nodes_read.name: FullDecision
historic_nodes_read.summary: Envelope pairing prompts, chain-of-thought trace, parsed decisions, raw AI response, and request timing.

historic_nodes_read.name: StrategyEngine
historic_nodes_read.summary: Strategy engine bound to a per-trader StrategyConfig; entry object for candidate selection, data fetching, and prompt building.

historic_nodes_read.name: NewStrategyEngine
historic_nodes_read.summary: Constructs a StrategyEngine from a StrategyConfig, optionally wiring the NofxOS data-wallet client.

historic_nodes_read.name: GetLanguage
historic_nodes_read.summary: Resolves the output language from config with auto-detection fallback.

historic_nodes_read.name: GetCandidateCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Builds the deduplicated candidate coin list by merging configured sources (static, AI500, OI top/low, Hyperliquid all/main) with per-source tagging, normalization, and exclusion filtering.

historic_nodes_read.name: filterExcludedCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Removes user-excluded symbols from the candidate list.

historic_nodes_read.name: getAI500Coins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches AI500 index constituents as candidate coins.

historic_nodes_read.name: getOITopCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches coins with the largest open-interest increases.

historic_nodes_read.name: getOILowCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches coins with the largest open-interest decreases.

historic_nodes_read.name: getHyperAllCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches all Hyperliquid-listed coins as candidates.

historic_nodes_read.name: getHyperMainCoins
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches main/high-volume Hyperliquid coins as candidates.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchExternalData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches user-configured external HTTP data sources for prompt injection.

historic_nodes_read.name: fetchSingleExternalSource
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches one external source with timeout, size caps, and JSON-path extraction.

historic_nodes_read.name: extractJSONPath
historic_nodes_read.summary: Extracts a dotted-path value from parsed JSON data.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchQuantData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches CoinAnk quant metrics (netflow, OI, price change) for a symbol.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchQuantDataBatch
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches quant metrics for multiple symbols concurrently.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchOIRankingData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches the open-interest change ranking snapshot.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchNetFlowRankingData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches the institutional/personal net-flow ranking.

historic_nodes_read.name: FetchPriceRankingData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Fetches the price-change ranking snapshot.

historic_nodes_read.name: ShouldSkipDecisionCycle
historic_nodes_read.summary: Gates the decision loop in futures mode: returns true when the CME session is closed so no AI cycle runs.

historic_nodes_read.name: ShouldBlockEntryForExpiry
historic_nodes_read.summary: Blocks new futures entries within 5 days of CME quarterly contract expiry, resolved via the Databento contract calendar.

historic_nodes_read.name: engine_position.go
historic_nodes_read.summary: Decision validation gate: per-decision checks for action whitelist, leverage caps with fallback, position-size ratios, stop/take-profit sanity, risk-reward and confidence minimums, and futures notional limits before signals reach execution.

historic_nodes_read.name: validateDecisions
historic_nodes_read.summary: Batch wrapper applying validateDecision to every decision in the parsed envelope.

historic_nodes_read.name: validateDecision
historic_nodes_read.summary: Validates a single decision: action whitelist, leverage caps and fallback, sizing ratios, stop/TP sanity, minimum risk-reward and confidence, and futures-aware notional caps.

historic_nodes_read.name: engine_prompt.go
historic_nodes_read.summary: Builds the crypto system and user prompts for the AI decision cycle — trading framework, risk rules, available-indicator docs, position/market/quant data formatting across configured timeframes — and routes futures prompt variants to the dedicated futures builder.

historic_nodes_read.name: BuildSystemPrompt
historic_nodes_read.summary: Assembles the system prompt: routes futures variants to buildFuturesPrompt, otherwise composes the crypto trading framework, risk control, indicator docs, and schema sections.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatKlineTimeframes
historic_nodes_read.summary: Lists the kline timeframes present on a market data snapshot.

historic_nodes_read.name: writeAvailableIndicators
historic_nodes_read.summary: Writes the available-indicators documentation section of the system prompt.

historic_nodes_read.name: BuildUserPrompt
historic_nodes_read.summary: Builds the user prompt with account state, open positions, candidate coins, multi-timeframe market data, and quant metrics.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatPositionInfo
historic_nodes_read.summary: Formats one open position with PnL and peak-PnL context for the prompt.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatCoinSourceTag
historic_nodes_read.summary: Renders the source tags (AI500/OI/static, etc.) attached to each candidate coin.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatMarketData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Formats a symbol's market data block: price, changes, indicators, open interest, and funding.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatTimeframeSeriesData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Formats per-timeframe kline series with the configured indicator values and periods.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatQuantData
historic_nodes_read.summary: Formats CoinAnk quant metrics (netflow and OI deltas) for the prompt.

historic_nodes_read.name: formatFlowValue
historic_nodes_read.summary: Humanizes large flow numbers into K/M/B units.

historic_nodes_read.name: risk_limits.go
historic_nodes_read.summary: Prop-firm style risk guardrails: pre-trade checks (daily loss, concurrent trades, notional and contract caps), daily PnL reset on CME session roll, toggleable daily guardrails, per-strategy limit resolution, and consistency-rule breach detection.

historic_nodes_read.name: RiskLimits
historic_nodes_read.summary: Hard risk caps (daily loss, concurrent trades, notional, contracts per order) with pre-trade checking and violation classification.

historic_nodes_read.name: CheckPreTrade
historic_nodes_read.summary: Pre-trade gate: rejects an order when daily loss, concurrent trades, notional, or contract caps would be breached.

historic_nodes_read.name: Classify
historic_nodes_read.summary: Classifies which limit a proposed trade violates for structured error reporting.

historic_nodes_read.name: LoadRiskLimitsFromConfig
historic_nodes_read.summary: Builds RiskLimits from environment/config values with defaults.

historic_nodes_read.name: ResetDailyPnL
historic_nodes_read.summary: Resets the tracked daily realized PnL at session roll.

historic_nodes_read.name: MaybeResetDaily
historic_nodes_read.summary: Resets daily counters when the CME session day rolls over.

historic_nodes_read.name: DailyGuardrails
historic_nodes_read.summary: Per-day toggleable guardrails: daily loss limit, profit target, and max trade count, behind a master toggle.

historic_nodes_read.name: Check
historic_nodes_read.summary: Evaluates enabled daily guardrails (loss limit, profit target, trade count) against today's stats.

historic_nodes_read.name: ResolveMaxContracts
historic_nodes_read.summary: Resolves the effective max-contracts cap through master toggle, per-guardrail toggle, per-strategy value, and env default.

historic_nodes_read.name: ResolveNotionalLeverage
historic_nodes_read.summary: Resolves the effective notional-leverage cap through the toggle/fallback chain.

historic_nodes_read.name: ConsistencyBreached
historic_nodes_read.summary: Prop-firm consistency rule: flags when today's profit exceeds the allowed percentage of total profit.

corrections: Only four assigned paths have historical nodes;26 current files absent.
engine.go fetchSingleExternalSource has unbounded io.ReadAll, not graph-claimed size cap.
Quant provider is NofxOS client, not graph-claimed direct CoinAnk.
RiskLimits has three fields, not a contract cap; cap resolver separate.
ResetDailyPnL updates key and latches; does not reset database/account PnL.
Graph package-import fanout includes test files; not actual source-level file import or runtime call edges.
GetCandidateCoins only mixed branch deduplicates; static retains duplicates.
